Embedding request via Azure OpenAI using the azure/ provider prefix — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape that Azure returns unchanged

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.embed(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(input: 'Hello world', model: 'azure/text-embedding-ada-002'))
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data[0].embedding.inspect
```
